public_deeper_reduction_evidence.statement: 0.5-s data averaging introduces a 2.57(1) ppm correction; double numerical differentiation introduces a 2058.71(1) ppm correction.
0.5-s data averaging introduces a 1.14(1) ppm correction; double numerical differentiation introduces a 914.35(1) ppm correction.
Residual co-moving background-gradient effects are reported as 1.86, 1.35 and 1.72 ppm for the three experiments; the lab-fixed background is frequency-separated.

The public materials inspected here do not provide the raw time-series/run records needed for depth 3 or 4; supporting data are stated to be available from corresponding authors on reasonable request.

source_definition_check.statement: P_g,l,m is defined from the pendulum/source multipole moments and moment of inertia; G appears as a separate multiplicative factor in the gravitational angular-acceleration expansion.
